title: Cyclomatic numbers and permutations
summary: We show that several apparently different aspects of a permutation are all tied to a single quantity, the cyclomatic number of its inversion graph. Every reduced word for the permutation orders the edges of the inversion graph one at a time, with the edges from first-occurrence letters forming a spanning forest and the edges from repeated letters accounting for the rest; the number of repeated letters is therefore the cyclomatic number.
